title: How all apps should be.
body: This is a beautifully designed app, simple to use but with a huge amount of depth if required. Want to exercise three times per week? Meditate for five minutes twice a day? Limit yourself to three drinks per week? It’s super easy to set up your tasks how you’d like, reminders how you’d like, and make changes whenever you want. And there are absolutely no ads or upsell options, no tracking. This has made my life better.

author: f383726166

title: Great habit tracker app!
body:
The best habit tracker app in my opinion. It’s comes at a very reasonable price and does what it promises to very well.

I got it about 3 weeks ago and have been using it every day since. I love that it works across iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. It syncs across them and integrates beautifully with Apple Health.

One improvement though, would be to make more pages available. Four isn’t enough. The graphs/insights could also be better.

Having tried a couple of trials for other Habit Trackers, I can say that this app is the best value for money. The others are a rip-off!
author: GiddyUpHorsey

title: Fantastic app, just a few minor holes
body:
Love this app, really helps me stay on top of life. Being able to link to an HTML let's me link to a checklist in Things3 or Trello with a habit stack. 

Couple of minor flaws
1. You can't track more than your target (I.e. if the targets 4 days a week you can't track a 5th day &
2. For weekly habits, there's no daily data, I can only see how I'm talking for the week& if the habit was completed on previous weeks, not what days it was completed on.
author: VasantP86

title: The Only Honest Habit
body:
This app is outstanding, not only for its clever design, but for the fact that it is the only app of its kind that is not trying to track you and sell your data, sell you an expensive BS subscription you don’t need, or both. In other words, it’s the only habit app not trying to scam you. 

There are still indie developers out their not on the grift, but they’re becoming harder to find.
